bio.text: Sarah Huckabee Sanders, a Republican, has been Governor of Arkansas since January 10, 2023, and is the Republican candidate for re-election in 2026.
She served in the Trump administration as deputy White House press secretary from January to July 2017 and as press secretary from July 2017 to June 2019.
Sanders was born in 1982 in Hope, Arkansas, is the daughter of former Governor Mike Huckabee, lives in Little Rock, and earned a degree from Ouachita Baptist University in 2004.
